T: If you completely forget your name, you'll never find your way back home.
D: Ten-year-old Chihiro takes a job in a witch's bathhouse for spirits to save her parents, who ate the wrong feast and turned into pigs.
P: Bring out the rice balls when Haku gives Chihiro onigiri after she finds her parents still pigs.
S: Rice balls with a pickled plum inside. Eaten through tears.

Rinse the rice until the water runs clear, then cook it with the water, covered, on low heat. Rest the rice for 10 minutes off the heat, then spread it out to cool a little. Wet and salt your hands, take a handful of rice, push a piece of plum into the middle and press into a triangle. Wrap a strip of nori around the base of each and sprinkle with sesame.
Sushi rolls of tuna and cucumber for the feast. No-Face pays the staff in gold.

Cook the sushi rice, then fold through the seasoning and cool to room temperature. Beat the eggs with the sugar, cook into a thin omelette and cut into strips. Lay a nori sheet on a bamboo mat, spread with rice, line up salmon and cucumber or egg, and roll up tightly. Slice each roll into 8 with a wet knife and serve with soy and ginger.
M: Spirit town char siu pork buns
Fluffy steamed buns of char siu pork, the feast that turns her parents into pigs

Coat the pork in the char siu sauce and leave for 15 minutes. Roast on a rack at 200C for 35 minutes, then brush with honey and soy and roast 10 minutes more until sticky. Rest, then slice thinly. Steam the buns until soft and puffy. Fill each bun with hoisin, pork, cucumber and spring onion.
Kamaji bribes Lin with a roasted newt

Simmer the soy, apple juice, sugar and ginger until syrupy, then cool. Cook the rice. Thread the chicken and spring onion onto the skewers. Grill over high heat, turning and brushing with the glaze, until charred and cooked through. Serve on the rice with the rest of the glaze.
W: Lin brings Sen a red bean bun

Mix the flour, yeast, baking powder and sugar, then add the milk and oil and knead to a smooth dough. Cover and leave somewhere warm until puffy. Divide into 10, flatten each, wrap around a spoonful of bean paste and pinch closed. Sit each on a square of baking paper and steam over boiling water until puffed and springy.
K: Zeniba's iced barley tea with honey and yuzu
Iced barley tea with honey and yuzu. Zeniba makes everyone some tea.
Steep the tea bags in the boiling water for 5 minutes, then remove and stir in the honey. Cool, add the yuzu and chill. Pour over ice to serve.
2 tbsp yuzu juice or lemon juice@Pantry
